The meatloaf has a textured, browned exterior with visible ground meat grains and is topped with a glossy red tomato-based glaze. To the right, there is a side salad with green leafy vegetables, white beans or corn, and a creamy dressing. The background is dark and out of focus, suggesting a restaurant or home dining setting.
